assessments.zone: Rural Lubao, Kamana and Tshofa secteurs (Lubao, Kamana, Tshofa, Samba, Kitenge, Ludimbi Lukula health zones)
assessments.evidence: These rural Songye/Luba villages have no reported armed-group territorial control. Order rests on scattered PNC posts at secteur and groupement level and on customary chiefs, and violence comes mainly from banditry and chieftaincy or land disputes. assessments.zone: Main towns: Lubao (territorial seat), Kamana (Karawa locality) and Tshofa (Nkongolo locality)
assessments.evidence: Territorial seat and secteur/health-zone centres with state administration, PNC commissariats and ANR, and probably small FARDC detachments. Policing and arrests are done by the PNC. No armed group is reported to hold these towns. Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted).

units.CD8108-lubao: Lubao territory (Lomami province) covers Lubao town and the Kamana and Tshofa areas between the Lomami and Lubilanji/Sankuru basins. No armed group is known to hold territory there: the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency touched Lomami only marginally and the Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga groups active in neighbouring Tanganyika (Kongolo, Kabalo) are not reported to control places inside Lubao. The main towns (Lubao, Kamana, Tshofa) have territorial administration and PNC commissariats; rural areas rely on thin PNC posts and customary chiefs, with insecurity mostly from banditry and chieftaincy or land disputes. Live web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule, with limited confidence.
